---
name: Responsible AI concern
about: Report concerns about the responsible use or behavior of AI in Scope.
---

See Scope's [Responsible AI FAQ](https://github.com/microsoft/scope/blob/main/docs/responsible-ai-faq.md) for intended uses, limitations, and safeguards.
Do not report security vulnerabilities publicly; follow [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/microsoft/scope/blob/main/SECURITY.md).
Do not include secrets, personal data, confidential code, or raw harmful content. Use redacted or synthetic examples and summarize sensitive outputs.

## Concern

Describe the concern, such as biased or unrepresentative benchmarks, unsupported Judge conclusions, misleading reports, harmful agent output, privacy risks, or overreliance on AI results. Identify the affected Scope feature.

## Potential impact

Who or what could be affected, and how? Distinguish observed effects from potential risks.

## Context and evidence

Describe the task, agent/model and worker versions, relevant prompts or criteria, and Scope version. Include safe reproduction steps, a sanitized example, or a run reference you can share publicly.
Explain what you observed and whether it recurs; do not rerun unsafe scenarios just to complete this report.

## Expected behavior

What would more responsible behavior look like, such as better evidence grounding, clearer limitations, more representative comparisons, or a human-review step?

## Suggested mitigation

If known, describe a change to Scope's behavior, evaluation criteria, documentation, or safeguards that could reduce the risk.
